categories.main_business_segments: Xiangyu Medical primarily operates in the rehabilitation medical device industry, focusing on the research, development, production, sales, and service of rehabilitation medical equipment. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio including rehabilitation evaluation devices, training devices, physiotherapy devices, assistive devices, and nursing equipment, covering over 20 series and 600 products. It also provides integrated clinical rehabilitation solutions and professional technical support services to medical institutions, elderly care facilities, rehabilitation centers, welfare institutions, educational systems, and individual consumers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as piezoelectric shockwave therapy, magnetic stimulation, laser and light therapy, biofeedback electrical stimulation, and intelligent robotic rehabilitation systems. It has developed proprietary core technologies including high-voltage pulse control, 3D dynamic motion feedback analysis, micro-pressure control, machine vision with robotic coordination, and multi-dimensional magnetic stimulation control. Production follows ISO13485 medical device quality management standards, with a complete in-house manufacturing capability covering key components and final assembly, supported by an industrial internet platform for smart manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xiangyu Medical serves a broad range of customers including hospitals at various levels, rehabilitation institutions, elderly care centers, disability rehabilitation centers, welfare homes, educational institutions, sports education systems, military units, and individual home users. Its products address clinical needs in pain management, orthopedic rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, post-operative recovery, postpartum rehabilitation, traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation, and home-based rehabilitation. The company also targets emerging markets such as accelerated rehabilitation surgery, smart elderly care, and rehabilitation assistive devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales coverage across 31 provincial-level administrative regions and over 300 prefecture-level cities. It has established sales and service teams nationwide, including in central, eastern, northern, northwestern, southwestern, southern, and northeastern China. Additionally, Xiangyu Medical is expanding its international presence, focusing on Belt and Road Initiative countries and regions, and actively pursuing CE and FDA certifications to facilitate overseas market entry.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiangyu Medical operates as an integrated manufacturer and supplier within the rehabilitation medical device supply chain. It controls upstream research and development, midstream manufacturing of key components and final products, and downstream sales and after-sales service. The company maintains comprehensive in-house production capabilities and manages procurement through a rigorous supplier evaluation system, positioning itself as a midstream to downstream player with strong vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation as its core growth driver, investing heavily in R&D with expenditures accounting for over 14% of revenue and a dedicated team of over 500 R&D personnel. It focuses on developing advanced rehabilitation technologies such as AI-enabled magnetic stimulation, rehabilitation robotics, brain-machine interfaces, and integrated multi-modal therapy devices. Xiangyu Medical also emphasizes building national-level innovation platforms, expanding R&D centers across multiple cities, and strengthening industry-academia collaborations to accelerate technology commercialization and maintain leadership in rehabilitation medical technology.
categories.revenue_model: Xiangyu Medical generates revenue primarily through the sale of rehabilitation medical devices and related products to institutional and individual customers. Sales are conducted mainly via indirect channels including distributors and agents, supplemented by direct sales to end customers and e-commerce platforms targeting home users. The company employs a buyout sales model with prepayment terms for indirect customers and recognizes revenue upon transfer of control of goods or services. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiangyu Medical is positioned as a leading R&D-driven comprehensive rehabilitation medical device manufacturer in China, distinguished by its broad product portfolio, strong innovation capabilities, and integrated clinical rehabilitation solutions. It holds a competitive advantage through extensive patent holdings, national-level certifications, and a wide sales network. The company competes with other domestic and international rehabilitation device manufacturers but maintains a strong market share and brand recognition, supported by its status as a national high-tech enterprise and multiple industry awards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Xiangyu Medical achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 744.8 million, representing a 52.46% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 227.1 million, up 81.03%, with net assets totaling RMB 2.09 billion, an 8.47% increase. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and asset base over recent years, supported by expanding market demand and continuous R&D investment. It employs over 1,800 employees, including a substantial R&D workforce, reflecting its scale and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiangyu Medical emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated rehabilitation solutions that cover a wide spectrum of clinical needs and patient populations. Its products incorporate advanced technologies such as AI, robotics, and multi-modal therapy integration, providing high efficacy, safety, and user-friendly operation. The company differentiates itself through strong proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, national-level certifications, and a robust after-sales service network. Its ability to deliver customized, clinically validated rehabilitation equipment and solutions positions it as a trusted partner for healthcare providers and patients seeking effective rehabilitation outcomes.
